channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: VScolonies
item.description: Build ur own colone with villagers who harvest resources, mine and build town!

item.title: ArcadiaSurfaceStability
item.description: A configurable temporal stability overhaul that keeps the surface safe.

item.title: The Sumpter (Class)
item.description: Adds a new class focused on logistics. Comes with exclusive clothing, backpacks, and saddlebags.

item.title: KarinServerCLassLock&Tweaks
item.description: Locks race-specific classes to their race and adds traits for the Karin Archipelago private server.

item.title: Vigor & CO Compatibility
item.description: Makes Combat Overhaul actions cost Vigor stamina

item.title: Flocks
item.description: Flocks is a mod that adds migratory flocks of birds, as well as new species of birds to the game.

item.title: Carry Carcass
item.description: Pickup animal carcasses, carry them in a backpack slot, and place them down elsewhere.

item.title: Sauce-a-lot
item.description: This mod adds several sauces that can be used in meals and for slathering onto meats!

item.title: Bed No Skip
item.description: Bed No Skip lets you lie down in a bed without skipping the night.

item.title: Snoopy's Block Logger (Server-side)
item.description: Server-side block logger - requires client side to view logs

item.title: Snoopy's Block Logger (Client-side)
item.description: Used to query server logs obtained through the Snoopy's Block Logger (Server-side) mod

item.title: Deciduous Trees
item.description: Lightweight mod where trees shed their leaves based on temperature. MAJOR 2.0 UPDATE!

item.title: VynilMod
item.description: A framework that adds a gramophone, a lathe, and a vinyl record (does not include music)

item.title: Incredible Edibles: The Incredible Gourd
item.description: A long deserved boost to pumpkins (And other modded gourds, when they appear).

item.title: Crown & Coalition Chapter 2
item.description: Chapter 2 additions for C&C.

item.title: Crown & Coalition Server Tweaks
item.description: For details on content, please contact me directly via Discord.

item.title: Open Inventory Command
item.description: Adds client-side commands to toggle inventory. Allows opening the survival inventory in creative.

item.title: Nature's Call REMADE
item.description: A rewrite of the legendary mod Nature's Call. No longer crashes the game when you pee on a friend

item.title: Sonya's Meat Mod
item.description: Adds animal-specific types of meat and fat and introduces more cooking options

item.title: Teapot's Undead Legion
item.description: Armed undead Revenants roam the night. Bind your own with a Temporal Core and lead them to battle!

item.title: Wilderlands Radial Comms
item.description: Adds a configurable radial comms feature to the game.

item.title: Dragonia Races Traits
item.description: Custom traits for server Dragonia

item.title: ND Patches
item.description: ND mulitple mod patches

item.title: Coal Specific Pile Burn Time
item.description: Coal pile burn duration that matches the coal used in the pile.

item.title: Vara's Boreal Lichens
item.description: Adds lichens to the northern ecosystems! So far just reindeer lichen.

item.title: Brickyard: Immersive Brickmaking
item.description: Adds in-world brickmaking in an immersive and involved manner.

item.title: Wandering Wilds - Berries
item.description: More bushes using the 1.22 style and mechanics. Currently adds 8 bushes.

item.title: homesteadmods
item.description: Homestead Server Tweaks

item.title: ClientConfigLimiter
item.description: Lets server owners lock client settings like brightness and gamma while players are in survival

item.title: Vintage Przygoda: Korony
item.description: Mod serwera Vintage Przygoda: Korony. Potrzebny tylko do gry na tym serwerze.
